items.caption: A seal-script-style rendering of 玉, the jade element conventionally analyzed as the semantic component in 現.
items.alt: A bold vertical stroke crossed by three horizontal strokes, forming 玉 in a seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: The visible form is identifiable as 玉 and illustrates the jade association in the conventional component analysis. It is a modern rendering of the component, not an early glyph of 現.

items.caption: A seal-script-style rendering of 見, conventionally analyzed as the sound component in 現.
items.alt: A rounded outline above a curved, leg-like lower form, depicting 見 in a seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: The visible form is identifiable as 見 and illustrates the proposed sound component. Its historical role in 現 is supported by conventional analysis and sound comparisons, but the drawing itself does not establish that role.

limitations.text: These are modern seal-script-style drawings of the proposed components, not historical glyphs of 現. They do not establish the character’s early form or a developmental sequence; no character-specific historical glyph of 現 is verified here.
